The '''Ranger Long Range Transceiver''' was a model of [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transceiver]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] and sold for 4800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
